subject: Budget range validation - PayBridge monthly spend band
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Garcia <elena@paybridge.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-28T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Budget range validation - PayBridge monthly spend band

Thanks for the call earlier, Elena - good to align. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can size the right commercial option:

Summary of usage we discussed:
- Typical steady-state: ~10M tokens / month
- Peak windows (product events): up to ~50M tokens / month
- Persona mix: ~70% generation, ~30% embeddings/reranking

Unit economics target:
- You mentioned a target of ~$800 / 1M tokens as a reference point - noted.

What we need from you to finalize the proposal:
1) Confirm monthly budget band (e.g., $10k- $50k) that procurement would prefer for the first 12 months.
2) Procurement thresholds: at what committed monthly spend do they require a formal PO / longer review? (PO threshold, legal lead-time)

I've attached a quick MRR/token estimate workbook (paybridge_mrr_estimates.xlsx) with a couple of scenarios - feel free to update.

Next steps:
- Once you confirm the budget band and PO thresholds I'll send a pricing proposal with two paths (on-demand vs committed) and the delta for a 12-month term.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: paybridge_mrr_estimates.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Elena Garcia <elena@paybridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: PayBridge Procurement <procurement@paybridge.com>
Date: 2026-05-29T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Budget range validation - PayBridge monthly spend band

Thanks for the summary, Marissa - this looks right to me.

Confirming the basics from our side:
- Expected monthly usage (first 6 months): 10M-50M tokens/month
- Target spend band: $10k- $50k / month initially
- Procurement thresholds: any committed spend >= $30k/month will need a formal PO and our legal review (typical lead time ≈ 4-6 weeks)

We are interested in seeing a 12-month committed option that hits the lower end of our unit economics (our internal target is ~$800 / 1M tokens). If you can show a committed plan that lands us at or below that mark at $25k+/month, procurement will be much more likely to push this through.

Please send the proposal and a DocuSign-ready agreement when available. Looping procurement on the thread - they may send a standard questionnaire separately.

Best,

Elena Garcia
Head of Product | PayBridge
elena@paybridge.com

Attachment: (none)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Garcia <elena@paybridge.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-30T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Budget range validation - PayBridge monthly spend band

Appreciate the clarity, Elena - attaching a short pricing proposal (redwood_pricing_proposal_v2.pdf) and an updated MRR/token tab.

High level options (summary):

1) On-demand (no commitment)
- $1,000 / 1M tokens
- Billed monthly; no minimum
- Good for flexibility and unpredictable spikes

2) Committed 12-month (recommended for predictability & unit economics)
- $800 / 1M tokens with a 12-month minimum term
- Minimum committed spend: $25k / month (can be structured as monthly invoice or quarterly advance)
- Includes dedicated priority routing and standard SLA

Example math (at $800 / 1M):
- 10M tokens -> $8,000 / month
- 25M tokens -> $20,000 / month
- 50M tokens -> $40,000 / month

Notes / asks:
- If procurement requires a PO for >= $30k/month we can structure invoicing to align with your process (monthly invoices and PO on file).
- I've CC'd Aditya (sales lead) and Connor (contracts) to start internal approval for the committed pricing and to prep a DocuSign template.

Next steps:
- Elena: confirm if $25k/mo minimum is acceptable as the gate for the committed discount and confirm procurement lead-time.
- Aditya/Connor: if OK, please confirm approval to offer the $800 / 1M committed rate for PB-2026-042.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments:
- redwood_pricing_proposal_v2.pdf (proposal stub)
- paybridge_mrr_estimates.xlsx (updated)

From: Elena Garcia <elena@paybridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: PayBridge Procurement <procurement@paybridge.com>
Date: 2026-06-01T08:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Budget range validation - PayBridge monthly spend band

Thanks - proposal received. We’ll run this by procurement today.

Quick answers:
- $25k/mo minimum looks reasonable as the threshold for the committed rate; procurement may still want to push PO threshold to $30k but I’ll confirm.
- Procurement lead time is ~4-6 weeks; if we can start onboarding and technical QA in parallel that would help accelerate live date.

Please send the DocuSign and a short SOW (1 page) we can attach to the PO.

Elena

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Budget range validation - PayBridge monthly spend band

Marissa - confirmed from my side: we can approve the committed rate at $800 / 1M tokens for a 12-month term with a $25k/month minimum for PB-2026-042. Connor, please prepare the DocuSign template and SOW draft (1 page) that aligns with our standard procurement terms. 

A couple of internal notes:
- If procurement pushes the PO threshold to $30k, we can accept a PO-based billing cadence; no change in rate.
- Flagging for finance: deal should be entered with monthly invoicing and a 30-day invoice term unless procurement requests otherwise.

Marissa - once you get procurement confirmation, send the DocuSign link and SOW to Elena and CC me.

Thanks,

Aditya Rao
Sales Director | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
